concept: Amber Ascent — senior fractional-CFO finance brand; structure, growth and diagnostic clarity. Deep-navy grounds, one warm-amber accent light, warm-paper highs. Step Rail motif = four bars in a +18% ascent. NO text, NO logos, NO charts-with-labels, NO AI-futurism, NO people, NO handshakes, NO mountains.

editorial-data.label: Editorial data macro
editorial-data.style_suffix: moody editorial macro photography of surfaces, light and numbers; deep matte navy ground with a single warm-amber glow as the only accent light; high contrast, shallow depth of field, premium and quiet; no text labels, no readable numerals, no logos, no AI-futurism, no charts UI

architectural.label: Fine-art architecture
architectural.style_suffix: fine-art architectural photography; strong geometry and repetition; deep navy tonality with one warm-amber directional light; clean, minimal, generous negative space; no people, no text, editorial not stock-glossy

precision-macro.label: Precision macro
precision-macro.style_suffix: precision macro photography of a single crafted object; matte deep-navy background, one warm-amber highlight, shallow depth of field; quiet, exact, premium; no text, no logos

still-minimal.label: Minimal still / interior
still-minimal.style_suffix: minimalist still-life and interior photography; calm ordered composition, generous negative space, matte surfaces; deep navy and warm-paper tonality with a single amber light accent; premium, quiet, no text, no people
